handed_over: This agent runs as a subagent inside the Muse app, which keeps no exportable session file for subagent runs; the session below is handed over from the visible transcript of the run.

messages.content: Build a second make.fun bounty entry, for the daily news-image competition "Sum up 25 November's world news in one image" (slug news-image-20261125, $100 escrow, 50 paid places, deadline 2026-11-27 08:00 CST). Same playbook as the 24 November entry (repo haoyi0323/makefun-news-image-20261124), same shape but better: verify the real 25 November 2026 world news from live web sources (do NOT use any news list from Gemini — it returned November 2024 events); make the front page stronger for pairwise AI judging (massive 2-3 word headline, one dominant centerpiece illustration, sidebar with big number callouts, rigid newspaper geometry, 1024x1024); build in ~/workspace/makefun/news-image-20261125/; download the 25th kit and use the existing Muse-owned account @golden-lynx-27-8409; create GitHub repo haoyi0323/makefun-news-image-20261125 with owner.json and badges from the start; DO NOT submit — report back the repo URL, HEAD sha, stories used, image description, and the exact submit command.

Verified the real 25 November 2026 news from live sources: Just Security's Early Edition (citing Reuters, AP, NYT, BBC) and a same-day world-news roundup. Eight stories chosen: (1) IRGC says two oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz; (2) Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura oil refinery, causing fires; (3) Ukrainian drones hit Rosneft's Syzran and Kuibyshev refineries, both ablaze, 145 drones downed; (4) Dow's first close above 50,000 at 50,018.70, KOSPI -6.16%, Nikkei -2.78%; (5) Dell record Q3 revenue $54.9B (+103%), AI servers $22.0B (+291%); (6) Shenzhou-24 docks with Tiangong carrying Pakistan's first astronaut; (7) Australia-Solomon Islands treaty barring any foreign military base; (8) RSF drone strikes kill 19 civilians in Sudan. Downloaded the 25th kit (kit.tar.gz, 8.5MB) and read kit.json, RULES.txt and competition.yaml: judge is z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, image at most 1 MiB and 1024x1024, prizes 1st $20 / 2nd $12 / 3rd $6 / 4th-10th $2 / 11th-50th $1.20.

Generated the hero illustration (two burning oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz at dusk, black smoke, orange fire on dark water, rocky coastline) and verified it visually. Wrote compose.py with the new layout: thick navy masthead with the date badge WEDNESDAY, 25 NOVEMBER 2026; massive two-word headline TANKERS ABLAZE (TANKERS in ink, ABLAZE in red, auto-fit to the full width); a deck; one dominant 944x280 illustration with caption; four more stories in the left column (Ukraine refineries, Sudan, Solomons pact, Shenzhou-24); and a right sidebar THE DAY IN NUMBERS with four big callouts (50,018.70 Dow, $54.9B Dell, -6.16% KOSPI, 145 drones). main.py is the deterministic copy program from the 24th entry (no network, no randomness, no clock). README.md carries the three make.fun badges and the bounty link from the start; LICENSE is MIT; .makefun/owner.json names the Muse-owned wallet.

Ran compose.py to build news.png (1024x1024), verified it visually and checked the size is under 1 MiB. Ran main.py twice and confirmed the two runs write byte-identical output (same sha256). Registered the kit CLI with the existing keypair (~/workspace/makefun/work/makefun-keypair.json, account @golden-lynx-27-8409). Created the public GitHub repo haoyi0323/makefun-news-image-20261125 with the custom.github helper, pushed all files including .makefun/owner.json in the first push, verified the tree and HEAD sha, and set the repo About (homepage, description, topics makefun, ai-agents, bounties, growth) via the GitHub API. Did not submit, as instructed; the exact bundle/check/submit commands are in SUBMIT.md for the top-level agent.
